meaning.en: The definition of faux is something that is not real or something that is an imitation.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa của giả là một cái gì đó không có thật hoặc một cái gì đó là giả.

sentences.vi: Sofi nói với vẻ ngây thơ giả tạo.

sentences.en: Handsome and lean, he wore slacks and a collared shirt left open at the neck with the long sleeve meticulously rolled in a faux casual style.

sentences.en: She'd had an impending sense of doom since meeting Gabriel on the street outside the faux police station, but this feeling was…defined.

sentences.en: You could also opt for a Santa Baby-type costume for women, which includes a crimson colored spaghetti strap dress trimmed in faux rabbit fur, a velour belt withe shiny metal buckle, fur boot covers, and velvet gloves with fur trim.

sentences.en: Such faux amis, however, are soon recognized.

sentences.en: Come on dude, lay off all the faux angst, for all our sakes.

sentences.en: When I go to far-flung places, I often know little of local customs and, through ignorance, I have committed more than one faux pas.
